subject: Using conditional statements on reactive variables

messages.author: e3c9e9dac899e76e
messages.subject: Using conditional statements on reactive variables
parts:
I have a reactive variable that gets generated by following statement and it works fine.

ozoneppb<-reactive({as.numeric(predict(object = fit,newdata = test()))})

But when I try using conditional statement on this variable as shown below, it throws me an error. If I try enclosing the entire conditional block inside the reactive, the airqltyindx variable is not visible outside of the reactive block.


if(ozoneppb()<=50)
    {
      airqltyindx<reactive(as.character("............."))
    }

Could someone help me fix this?

Thank you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Using conditional statements on reactive variables
parts:
I assume the error you see is airqltyindx not defined. What do you expect to happen here? If ozonepbb() is >50, what should airqltyindx be? And if ozonepbb can change over time, how do you expect airqltyindx to be updated?

I think it's more likely you want:

airqltyindx <- reactive({
  if (ozonepbb() <= 50) {
    ...
  } else {
    ...
  }
})

No?
